title: Filipino-Style Grilled Pork Sisig
description: A classic Filipino dish made with grilled pork's face, served with a sizzle of calamansi, chili peppers, and a sprinkle of onions. This recipe brings together the bold flavors of the Philippines in a delicious and easy-to-make dish.
instructions: Grill the pork face over medium heat until lightly charred, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Let the pork cool down, then chop it into small pieces.
In a pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the onions and sauté for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Add the chopped pork and stir to combine.
Add the calamansi juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and garnish with sliced chili peppers.
This dish is best served with steamed rice or as a topping for a Filipino-style nacho.
